props.name: date
props.description: Any day in the week shown, controlled.

props.name: defaultDate
props.description: Any day in the starting week, when uncontrolled. Defaults to today.

props.name: onDateChange
props.description: Called with the first day of the new week after previous, next or today.

props.name: scrollToHour
props.description: Hour scrolled into view on mount.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling grid, in pixels.

props.name: slotMinutes
props.description: Minutes an empty-slot click snaps to, and the length of the slot it reports.

props.name: onEventSelect
props.description: Called when an event is activated.

props.name: onSlotCreate
props.description: Called with the slot under an empty-grid click — the place to open a “New event” form.

props.name: now
props.description: The current moment, for the now line. Defaults to the clock, updated each minute.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for day and time labels.
